title: JADEPUFFER: first largely AI-run ransomware attack documented
summary: Sysdig documented an attack in which an LLM agent ran reconnaissance, credential theft, lateral movement, encryption and the ransom note after a human chose the target.
reason: AI-enabled cyberattack with agentic execution (rubric T2 up).

title: Albany council backs New York statewide data-center construction pause
summary: Albany's Common Council voted 13-0 to support a one-year statewide moratorium on hyperscale data centers, which the legislature passed in June and which awaits Gov. Hochul's signature.
reason: Local backing for a state moratorium; pending signature.
